display.summary: The beta-channel rehearsal, re-cut so its release page carries the artifacts: b1 published correctly to PyPI but attached no files.
highlights: Stable and beta are separate channels. Stable is the default and excludes every prerelease; beta is an explicit opt-in in Options.
A Git tag decides its own publication: v1.9.0b1 is a prerelease that never claims the 'latest' pointer, v1.9.0 is stable.
Prerelease ordering is computed by PEP 440 rather than by pattern-matching, so 1.9.0b2 < 1.9.0b10 < 1.9.0rc1 < 1.9.0 holds everywhere.
